body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes the missing styles issue in the CRM example when deployed to Vercel by adding the required Tailwind CSS v4 build configuration. Tailwind v4's new architecture requires explicit PostCSS plugin configuration and source scanning directives to generate utility classes during the build process.

**Changes:**
- Added `postcss.config.js` with `@tailwindcss/postcss` plugin and autoprefixer
- Added `@source` directives to `index.css` to specify paths for Tailwind class scanning
- Added `@tailwindcss/postcss` v4.1.18 as a dev dependency

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | Added lockfile entry for @tailwindcss/postcss v4.1.18 in crm-app devDependencies |
| `examples/crm-app/src/index.css` | Added @source directives to scan packages for Tailwind utility classes |
| `examples/crm-app/postcss.config.js` | Created PostCSS configuration with @tailwindcss/postcss and autoprefixer plugins |
| `examples/crm-app/package.json` | Added @tailwindcss/postcss v4.1.18 as dev dependency |

<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>
Fixed in commit d9c245c. Added `@source '../../packages/react/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}';` to scan the React package for Tailwind classes.
